description: This file defines a PHP class 'DoTokenParser' within the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'do' tags in templates which evaluate expressions without returning a value.

classes.name: DoTokenParser
classes.description: Parses 'do' tags in Twig templates which evaluate an expression and discard the output.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'do' tag, extracting an expression and returning a DoNode.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'do'.
